So there is NO MD-DERISK-ONLY-ROSTER-CUT candidate today under the bar that mandate actually keys on -- this is the primary answer to the B1-failure question and it is a clean negative, checked with the tool rather than re-derived by hand. SEPARATE, NARROWER OBSERVATION, not a B1 failure: applying the FULLER three-clause bar used for FRESH S1->S2 promotions (operator, 2026-09-21: n>=30 net of full cost, majority of walk-forward folds positive, cost tolerance) to the 9 ALREADY-LIVE legs, 6 of 9 would not clear it if evaluated fresh today: trend_donchian_eth_4h (n=44 OK, folds_positive 2/4 -- NOT majority), trend_donchian_xrp_4h (n=16 <30), ief_pullback_1d (n=3 <30), slv_pullback_1d (n=11 <30 AND folds_positive 2/4), iaum_pullback_1d (n=7 <30), trend_donchian_sol_prop (n=65 OK, folds_positive 2/4 -- NOT majority). Filed so a later review does not have to re-derive which legs are 'clears bar' vs 'grandfathered', and so the gap is visible if the operator wants to decide whether the standing roster should be held to the same bar as new admissions.
